title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E44 — Beat the Unbeaten: Back for Revenge
Competitor turned Judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge, but soon that could all change; two of the smiths who faced Ben in his very first competition are back to seek their revenge in a single 5-hour showdown.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Championship Supersized Weapons
"Forged in Fire" Judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top supersized weapons to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Championship Throwing Weapons
Judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top throwing weapons to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E41 — Beat the Unbeaten: Round One
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths compete in a single 5-hour round; their blades will be put through an intense round of testing, and only one will earn the opportunity to face off against Ben Abbott.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E43 — Beat the Unbeaten: Broken Blade Revenge
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths who suffered broken blades hope to rewrite history in a 5-hour round; their blades will be tested, and one of them will get the chance to face off against Ben Abbott.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E45 — Beat the Unbeaten: The Final Showdown
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott still remains undefeated in the forge with a record of 8-0, but two smiths handpicked by Doug and Dave want to change that; after a tough five-hour forging round, their weapons must survive a round of testing.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E42 — Beat the Unbeaten: Scrap Steel Challenge
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths compete in a 5-hour round during which they make blades out of scrap steel; these blades will be tested, with one smith getting the chance to take on Ben.

The marksmen fire the Browning M1919 from a rolling Army half-track; competitors call the shots in a game of horse.

The final four must crawl through a tunnel, dodge barbed wire and slither through mud with an AK-47.

A returning challenge receives a daring makeover; the Rutgers Security Six revolver; contestants try to cleanly fire a bullet through a narrow tube.

description:
S02 E21 — License to Pawn
Corey and Rick have a chance to make a deal on a 1980 10th anniversary edition Datsun ZX; 1862 Civil War postage stamp; cast member's script from the 1964 James Bond film "Goldfinger."

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E20 — American Hero
A helicopter flight helmet from the Vietnam War is brought in for restoration; Rick uses a 1940s Coke machine with lettering issues to teach Tyler a lesson.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S10 E43 — United We Stand
Rick and Corey look at a BSA bike from WWII; Rick and Chumlee find a pair of Roberto Clemente prototype sneakers.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S10 E31 — The Chum System
A nightstick possibly owned by Ulysses S. Grant comes into the shop; a set of vintage skateboard stickers; Chumlee tries to prove that he is a multitasking master.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S10 E05 — Pawn Apocalypse
Rick deals for vintage Aerosmith T-shirts; Rick and Corey barter for a U.S. Navy foghorn; Corey checks out a vehicle built to fight off a zombie apocalypse.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S10 E06 — Colts and Vikings
A Colt Army Model 1860 comes into the shop; Rick barters for a Viking coin; Chumlee tries to get a raise using subliminal messages.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E23 — Top Secret
Top-secret maps and battle plans for Iwo Jima; the Old Man and Chumlee look to buy a 1967 Ford F-100; Corey and Chumlee have the chance to buy an 1860s ore cart.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E24 — Whale of a Time
An engraved whale's tooth may be authentic 19th-century scrimshaw; Civil War-era rifles; a pristine copy of Playboy's first issue.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S10 E19 — Birthday Blues
A military ID signed by Marilyn Monroe comes into the shop; a customer has a first edition of Beethoven's 6th Symphony.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S11 E08 — Rick Gets Axed
A piece of original artwork from the 1995 Batman-Spider-Man crossover comic comes into the shop; Rick looks at a deadly Revolutionary War halberd; Chum's complaints inspire a casual Friday at the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S11 E13 — All Hail Rick
Revolutionary War documents signed by King George III come into the shop; a pair of Cushman Scooters; the guys all take part in a competitive shoot-out after checking out a BB gun in the shop.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E15 — Anchors Away

description:
